name: Fans & Pumps Control
description: Electrical control and wiring for the high-current motor loads: radiator fan (OE ZL1 brushless PWM fan), fuel pumps (OE ZL1 PWM-controlled pump module or race lift/ surge pumps), LT4 intercooler coolant pump, transmission/diff cooler pumps and fans, cool-suit pump and wiper motor. These are the largest continuous loads and set the alternator and PDM sizing.

components.name: Radiator cooling fan (electrical)
components.description: Electric fan behind the radiator/heat-exchanger stack. The 2016–2020 supercharged 6.2 L Camaro uses a brushless fan with integral controller commanded by PWM (aftermarket users report GM 158927; 2021+ replacement 85516898 uses a different control scheme). A race car can drive it from a PDM PWM output or the ECU's fan output, or switch to a SPAL brushless/brushed fan with PDM soft-start.
components.location: Behind the radiator, centered (x≈-0.58, y≈0.45, z=0).

factory.name: GM brushless PWM radiator fan (6.2 L supercharged Camaro 2016–2020)
factory.notes: Integral controller; needs heavy power/ground (8–10 AWG) and a PWM command.

raceOptions.name: SPAL brushless 850 W class fan
raceOptions.notes: PWM-controlled; ensure PDM channel/ fuse sized to peak current (~60+ A).

specs.Power: ~850 W class (~60–70 A at full speed)

installNotes: Feed power from a fused direct circuit or paired PDM outputs – the fan's peak current can exceed a single 20 A PDM channel; use the PDM for the PWM/enable signal and a high-current relay/fused feed if needed.
inspection: Fan runs at commanded duty; blade damage from debris.

sources.title: Wrangler TJ forum – Camaro 850 W brushless fan 158927 notes
HPA – PWM control for brushless fans

modelRef.dimensions: Same fans as engine-support.cooling.fan-assembly (Ø~330 mm each).
modelRef.features: Electric fans behind the radiator; shown at the engine-support fan location.

components.name: Fan control (PDM PWM / ECU / standalone controller)
components.description: Generates the fan PWM command from coolant temperature (and A/C or vehicle speed). Options: ECU fan output (E92 kit), PDM PWM channel with CAN coolant temp, or a standalone controller like the Lingenfelter VSFM-002 (min/max temperature set points).
components.location: PDM in cabin; standalone controller in engine bay.

raceOptions.name: Lingenfelter VSFM-002 variable speed fan module
raceOptions.notes: Forum reports it drives the 850 W Camaro fan through full range.

hardware.item: Standalone fan controller mounting screws (if used)

hardware.spec: Deutsch DT or supplied sealed plug

installNotes: Program post-run fan (cool-down after key-off) with a timer, and fan-on at low speed in the pits.

modelRef.dimensions: Same module as engine-support.cooling.fan-controller (~100 x 80 x 40 mm).
modelRef.features: Sealed fan control module near the radiator support.

components.name: Fuel pump control (PWM module / PDM channels)
components.description: The ZL1 in-tank pump is PWM-controlled by a fuel pump power/flow control module commanded by the ECM (from the low-side fuel pressure sensor). The Chevrolet Performance controller kit includes a fuel pump power module. Race options: Katech Gen 6 dual-pump controller (10–22 V, 40 A min continuous) or PDM PWM channels driving lift/ surge pumps in a fuel-cell system.
components.location: Trunk near the fuel tank/cell (OE module area is passenger side of trunk per Katech install steps) or PDM in cabin.

factory.name: GM fuel pump power control module (in LT controller kit)

raceOptions.name: Katech PNP harness/controller for Gen 6 dual fuel pump module
Aeromotive BoostWorx PWM fuel module controller (ZL1/LSA)

installNotes: Program pump prime (2–3 s at key-on) and pump-off on engine-kill / no rpm (safety).
inspection: Fuel pressure stability under hard cornering and on low fuel.

sources.title: Katech ZL1 dual fuel pump wiring install
Jegs – ZL1 pump is PWM via controller

modelRef.features: Finned aluminium module with two sealed connectors.

components.name: Fuel pump power & ground harness
components.description: Heavy-gauge feed/ground to each fuel pump (typ. 12 AWG per pump, 10 AWG for long runs), with sealed connectors through the fuel cell/tank plate bulkhead and grounds to the rear ground stud – never to the cell plate.

factory.name: GM fuel pump harness to module

installNotes: Keep wiring outside the cell's vapor space; use fuel-resistant sleeve inside the cell can.
inspection: Connector heat (high resistance shows as discoloration).

modelRef.dimensions: 12 AWG pairs in a Ø~10 mm sleeve.
modelRef.features: Black sleeved branch to the fuel-cell top plate.

components.name: LT4 intercooler (charge-cooler) coolant pump
components.description: Electric pump circulating low-temperature coolant from the front heat exchanger through the supercharger intercooler bricks. On a race car, run it continuously at full speed whenever the engine runs (PDM channel) and log its current – a failed pump means high charge temps and knock retard.
components.location: Front of car near the heat exchanger, low (x≈-0.60, y≈0.30, z≈+0.35).

raceOptions.name: Bosch PAL / Pierburg CWA-series high-flow pump

inspection: Pump current in data; air in loop.

modelRef.dimensions: Same pump as engine-support.intercooler-loop.ic-pump (~150 x 70 mm).
modelRef.features: Shown at the engine-support intercooler pump location.

components.name: Transmission/differential cooler pumps & fans
components.description: Electric pumps (and small fans) for transmission and differential coolers, switched by PDM from temperature sensors with hysteresis.
components.location: Trans cooler near tunnel / diff cooler in rear (x≈3.1, y≈0.35).

factory.name: None on manual cars (ZL1 1LE has diff/trans coolers – passive/air)

raceOptions.name: Tilton / Setrab / Fluidyne diff cooler pump kit

modelRef.features: Black motor can with inlet/outlet ports.

components.name: Driver cooling (cool-suit) pump
components.description: 12 V pump circulating ice water through the driver's cooling shirt; PDM channel with keypad toggle and variable duty.
components.location: Passenger floor in cooler box (x≈1.8, y≈0.25, z≈-0.40).

modelRef.dimensions: Coolshirt 12 V circulation pump ~100 x 65 mm, mounted on the cooler lid (cooler drawn by interior.driver-cooling.coolshirt-cooler)
modelRef.features: White cooler body with blue lid, pump outlet/return fittings on top.

components.name: Windshield wiper motor control
components.description: Most series require a working wiper. Retain the OE Gen 6 wiper motor (single-arm or OE) driven from a PDM H-bridge/ wiper output (ECUMaster PMU16 and Cartek PDP have dedicated wiper functions with park input), or fit a lightweight race wiper kit.
components.location: Cowl, below windshield base (x≈0.62, y≈0.90, z≈+0.20).

raceOptions.name: Single-arm race wiper kit (e.g. WipeTech/ Bosch-based)

installNotes: Wire park switch to PDM so the blade parks out of sight-line.

modelRef.features: Cast gearbox with motor can, under the cowl.
